0022600137.text: The Chicago Bulls host the New York Knicks with the Bulls at 1-3 this season, 0-1 at home, and on a two-game losing streak, sitting 4th in the Central and 11th in the East. New York is winless at 0-3, on a three-game losing streak, and 13th in the East, and it will be without Jose Alvarado (ankle sprain), while Chicago is missing Nic Claxton (hamstring) and Patrick Williams (groin soreness). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and last season the Bulls lost 1-3, including a 136-96 loss in New York on April 3, 2026.
